title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning Judicial Suggestions on Comprehensive Governance

articles.content_en: 第一条 These Provisions shall apply where a People's Court, in the exercise of its adjudication and enforcement functions, discovers prominent issues in the field of social governance that give rise to frequent and concentrated disputes and conflicts, affect economic and social development, and impair the protection of the rights and interests of the people, and the Court deems it necessary to propose judicial suggestions to the competent authorities or other relevant entities for improvement of work and governance.
第二条 A People's Court, when proposing judicial suggestions, shall adhere to the principle of genuine necessity, ensuring the pertinence, standardization, and effectiveness of the judicial suggestions.

第三条 When proposing judicial suggestions, a People's Court shall address them to the corresponding competent authorities or other relevant entities based on the industries, fields, etc. involved in the comprehensive governance issues; where addressed to a competent authority, they shall generally be addressed to the competent authority at the same level within the Court's jurisdiction. Where the discovered comprehensive governance issues require measures to be taken by a competent authority in another locality, a work suggestion may be submitted to the corresponding higher People's Court for decision.
第四条 Judicial suggestions shall be proposed in the name of a People's Court.

第五条 Before proposing a judicial suggestion, a People's Court shall conduct full investigation and research in conjunction with the issues discovered in adjudication and enforcement work, and actively communicate with the proposed recipient unit to seek its opinions.

第六条 A People's Court, when proposing a judicial suggestion, shall produce a Judicial Suggestion Document.
Judicial Suggestion Documents shall be uniformly numbered.

第七条 After the draft of the Judicial Suggestion Document is completed, it shall be submitted to the Adjudication Committee for deliberation in accordance with Article 37, Paragraph 1, Item 4 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China.
After the Judicial Suggestion Document is approved through deliberation, it shall be signed and issued by the President of the Court.

第八条 When proposing a judicial suggestion, a People's Court shall inform the proposed recipient unit to provide a written reply regarding the adoption and implementation of the suggestion. The reply period shall be determined according to the specific circumstances, generally not exceeding two months; where laws or judicial interpretations provide otherwise, those provisions shall prevail.
A People's Court shall, in conjunction with its adjudication and enforcement work, support, cooperate with, and supervise the proposed recipient unit in taking corresponding measures, and collaborate to ensure the implementation of the relevant work of the judicial suggestion.

第九条 Where the issues involved in a judicial suggestion are significant and require high attention, a People's Court may serve a copy of the Judicial Suggestion Document to the higher competent authority of the proposed recipient unit or other relevant entities.

第十条 People's Courts at all levels shall designate a daily management institution for judicial suggestion work, improve mechanisms for review, guidance, assessment, incentives, etc., and incorporate the quality and efficiency of judicial suggestion work into performance appraisal.

第十一条 People's Courts at all levels shall, in accordance with Article 9 of the Organic Law of the People's Courts of the People's Republic of China, include the work of judicial suggestions in the matters reported to the People's Congress and its Standing Committee at the same level.

第十二条 Where a People's Court proposes judicial suggestions other than those of the comprehensive governance type, they shall be handled in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws, judicial interpretations, and other normative documents. Matters not provided for in relevant laws, judicial interpretations, or other normative documents may be handled by reference to these Provisions based on the specific circumstances and actual needs of the jurisdiction.

第十三条 These Provisions shall come into force on November 16, 2023. Where judicial interpretations and other normative documents previously issued by the Supreme People's Court are inconsistent with these Provisions, these Provisions shall prevail.

Annex 1
Specification for the Preparation of Judicial Suggestion Documents of People's Courts
To guide the preparation of Judicial Suggestion Documents by courts across the country, ensure uniform format, complete elements, complete structure, appropriate length, logical coherence, accurate terminology, and improve document quality, this specification is formulated.
I. Basic Elements
A Judicial Suggestion Document consists of three parts: heading, main text, and closing.
II. Heading
The heading includes the title, the Judicial Suggestion Document number, and the name of the proposed recipient unit.
The title includes the court name, subject matter, and the words "Judicial Suggestion Document". For example: "×× People's Court Judicial Suggestion Document on ××".
Judicial Suggestion Documents shall be uniformly numbered. The Judicial Suggestion Document of the Supreme People's Court shall be numbered in the form of "Fajian" + [year of document] + document number + "No."; the Judicial Suggestion Documents of local People's Courts at various levels shall be numbered in the form of abbreviation of place name + "Fajian" + [year of document] + document number + "No.".
The name of the proposed recipient unit shall use its full name, standardized abbreviation, or the collective name for the same type of unit.
III. Main Text
Briefly state the importance of working in the relevant field and the main measures and achievements already taken by the proposed recipient unit in that field. Then list the issues found in adjudication and enforcement work in that field that need attention, specific suggestions based on laws, regulations, and policies, the feedback deadline, and other matters requiring explanation. Suggestions and issues shall correspond one by one.
IV. Closing
Includes the court seal, court name and date, contact person's name and telephone number, annexes, and names of copied units.
If there are annexes to the Judicial Suggestion Document, the serial numbers and names of the annexes shall be noted after the main text and before the date of issuance.
The copied units shall use their full names, standardized abbreviations, or collective names for the same type of organization.
V. Cover
1. The court emblem pattern is 55mm high and 50mm wide. The top margin is 60mm, and the distance from the lower edge of the court emblem to the upper edge of the title text is 40mm.
2. The title text is "×× People's Court Judicial Suggestion Document", located below the court emblem pattern, in small-standard Song typeface; the title is arranged in two or three lines, with the court name font size 30pt and the Judicial Suggestion Document font size 36pt.
3. The cover shall be solemn and aesthetically pleasing; margins, font sizes, and line spacing may be appropriately adjusted.
